Sandbox_QoLforSacriel_EnableMod_tooltip: Master switch for all QoL for Sacriel modules.
Sandbox_QoLforSacriel_DebugLogs_tooltip: Print module debug logs to console.
Sandbox_QoLforSacriel_EnableDragDrop_too: Enable fatigue and endurance tuning for drag, transfer, and corpse-drag actions.
Sandbox_QoLforSacriel_EnableRestSleep_to: Enable rest and sleep quality-of-life actions.
Sandbox_QoLforSacriel_EnableEquipment_to: Enable equipment presets and equipment hotkey controls.
Sandbox_QoLforSacriel_Equipment_EnablePr: Enable Equipment Presets menu and Ctrl+F1..F8 hotkeys.
Sandbox_QoLforSacriel_EnableArmorMood_to: Enable armor discomfort gain rebalance behavior.
Sandbox_QoLforSacriel_UIFixes_SkillFilte: If enabled, show skills with partial XP even when level is 0.
Sandbox_QoLforSacriel_UIFixes_EnableWate: Show approximate natural-water depth hints in right-click water action tooltips.
Sandbox_QoLforSacriel_UIFixes_WaterDepth: How many tiles around the player to scan for water depth hints.
Minimum natural water tiles in the scan window to count as shallow.
Minimum natural water tiles in the scan window to count as medium.
Minimum natural water tiles in the scan window to count as deep.
Sandbox_QoLforSacriel_DragDrop_FatigueSt: Multiplier applied to early drag fatigue contribution.
Sandbox_QoLforSacriel_DragDrop_FatigueMa: Upper cap for drag fatigue multiplier over time.
Sandbox_QoLforSacriel_DragDrop_RampSecon: Seconds required to reach maximum multiplier while dragging/transferring.
Sandbox_QoLforSacriel_RestSleep_SleepyTh: Fatigue value where rest-until-sleepy should stop (default 0.3 when sleep is available).
Sandbox_QoLforSacriel_RestSleep_Interrup: Stop automated resting when movement input is detected.
Stop automated resting if panic reaches the configured value threshold.
Sandbox_QoLforSacriel_RestSleep_PanicInt: Panic value threshold (0-100) that interrupts rest-until-sleepy.
Sandbox_QoLforSacriel_Equipment_PresetCo: How many equipment presets are available in menus and hotkeys (Ctrl+F1..F8).
Sandbox_QoLforSacriel_ArmorMood_BaseRedu: Reduction factor applied to discomfort gain while armor is worn.
Sandbox_QoLforSacriel_ArmorMood_UpdateCo: Minimum seconds between armor mood recalculations.
